description: Header file defining the MonoPipe class, a specialized single-reader, single-writer pipe for audio data in Android's media framework. It includes class declarations, member functions, and related types for managing a mono audio pipe with blocking and shutdown capabilities.

classes.name: MonoPipe
classes.description: A class representing a mono audio pipe supporting a single reader and writer, with blocking and shutdown features.

methods.name: availableToWrite
methods.description: Returns the number of frames available for writing.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the pipe from a buffer.

methods.name: getAvgFrames
methods.description: Returns the target fill level of the pipe.

methods.name: setAvgFrames
methods.description: Sets the target fill level of the pipe.

methods.name: maxFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of frames the pipe can hold.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Sets the shutdown state for the write side of the pipe.

methods.name: isShutdown
methods.description: Checks if the write side of the pipe is shut down.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last write operation.
